title: WorldPainter: Alt+click samples the layer value under the cursor into the brush

sections.what: Holding Alt and clicking a painted cell sets the active layer's value to whatever is on that cell, so the author can keep painting with a tile they see without hunting for it in the palette.
sections.why: Searched editor.ts for altKey, eyedrop and sample: 0 matches, so no sampler exists. The Inspect tool (I) reads a cell but never feeds the brush. The palette has 106 biome tiles across up to 26 categories, so finding a tile you can already see is the slow part of extending a region.
sections.how: In the canvas pointer handler, when altKey is held on mousedown over a painted cell, read the value from the payload layer map for state.layer using GM().cellValue, set state.value, and render. Do not start a stroke. If the cell has no value on the active layer, say so in the status line. Add a line to the Paint tool hint.

acceptance.text: Alt+click on a cell painted dense_forest on the biome layer makes dense_forest the active value.
Alt+click on an empty cell leaves the value unchanged and says why in the status line.
No paint request is sent by an Alt+click.
